---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for the editor
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

### Problem

What problem does this feature solve? (e.g. "I want to edit X, but the editor
only lets me change Y.")

### Proposed solution

Describe the feature and how it should behave. If it changes the hero screen,
keep in mind the UI is a 1:1 port of fheroes2's map-editor hero screen — game
look and feel takes priority.

### Alternatives considered

What other approaches have you thought about, and why are they worse?

### Additional context

Anything else that helps: mockups, links, examples. For bigger ideas, the
[roadmap](https://github.com/slavamokerov/fheroes2-save-editor#roadmap) in the
README lists the wider picture — a related item there is worth mentioning.
